owner_and_capability: Enrollment — phase administration, form schemas, phase response overview, expiry warnings, approved-offering projection, captcha verification and parent notifications in modules/enrollment (#3562)
atomic_cutover: The phase, schema, expiry, response, projection, captcha and notification implementations move together from services/enrollment to the Enrollment application. Compose binds typed settings, Care Plan reads, the platform outbox and a Turnstile adapter; the Postgres adapter translates phase constraint errors. The 21 retained implementation files are deleted with no second provider. The remaining request and decision flows continue to own their decoded answer maps until #3564 and #3565.
tests: The moved phase, form-schema, expiry, response and notification suites run through modules/enrollment/enrollmenttest and the retained enrollment service tests.
The public enrollment router suites exercise the composed captcha verifier and unchanged submission contract.
scripts/backend-architecture.sh check and scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast verify the architecture ratchet and affected packages.
